registration.statement: A closed molecular turn divided into n symmetry-indistinguishable positive ligand sectors has no lawful unequal-sector form: unequal parts would introduce an ungenerated distinction. Each sector is therefore exactly 1/n turn and a retained k-sector separation is exactly k/n turn. The structural fractions seal without degrees; only afterward are all four NIST CCCBDB BF3, XeF2 and XeF4 angle rows opened.
